title: Re-pin opum-output-styles from main to the v0.1.0 tag
description: DEC-168 (7): every listing should pin a release, so opum-output-styles moves from a branch pin (ref main) to a release tag. opum-output-styles (opum-ai/opum-output-styles, MIT) is an output-styles plugin: it ships output-styles/ and no skills/ directory. Its dev and main both point at 87b427c208c415d9bdf18eadf2c9b7c970e45d55, so no dev:main promotion was needed. v0.1.0 was tagged on that commit and pushed (opum-doc approved the public tag push via the in-pane question route). Chain resolved via the GitHub git-database API: annotated tag object c5f4fc5acf6eb1fe7aabc6a9e5ae6cc2ad8b9214 -> commit 87b427c2 -> root tree 0e5199ae9037baf6953a37e25465c458fa2bf80a -> output-styles subtree 80f1ec2047722bcfb577c8fd532b74412340da5e. The plugin content is unchanged (this only converts a branch pin to a tag pin); ODOC-450 owns the lore/quest integration.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The opum-output-styles v0.1.0 annotated tag is on opum-ai/opum-output-styles main (commit 87b427c2)
The opum-output-styles entry in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json changes ref from main to v0.1.0

scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json records the re-resolved output-styles subtree 80f1ec2047722bcfb577c8fd532b74412340da5e in the same change; check-federated-pins and check-federated-content name opum-output-styles checked and verified (no longer out of scope); .agents/plugins/marketplace.json regenerated; lore check exits 0
The re-pin lands through a PR into dev with the required checks green on the head

finalSummary: OMARK-88 done. Re-pinned opum-output-styles from ref main to ref v0.1.0 in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, so every listing pins a release. v0.1.0 was tagged on the commit main carried (87b427c2) and pushed (opum-doc approved the public tag push via the in-pane question route); the plugin content is unchanged (ODOC-450 owns the lore/quest integration). The baseline records the re-resolved output-styles/ subtree 80f1ec2047722bcfb577c8fd532b74412340da5e in the same change. Landed through PR opum-ai/opum-marketplace#206 (deliverable commit c758a6f55f) with check · manifests, Tracker integrity and lore check all green; all nine entries are now checked by both federated checkers.
